name: Nimue Silver Pool
passives: Living Grove: terrain and sustain effects grow stronger over time.
lore: Nimue Silver Pool is a colossal Tuatha Titan shaped by the living world adapts and endures. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Emerald, silver, living wood, ancient stones, roots, bark-bronze skin, antler crowns, moonlit grove power. The silhouette must be colossal, non-human, readable on mobile, and unmistakably Tuatha.
developmentStatus: Playable data scaffold complete; artwork pending.
